land_pattern.package: 7-bar solder-bar row, mixed round/elongated pad geometry
land_pattern.notes: SCHEMA LIMITATION: pad_size_mm above captures only the 3 elongated BAR pads (pins 3,4,5 = drain/drain/source): die-bump 0.25mm wide x 0.70mm long, solder-mask opening ~0.23 x 0.68mm. The other 4 pads (pins 1,2,6,7 = gate/source/source/substrate) are ROUND instead: die-bump diameter 0.25mm (0.247-0.253mm), solder-mask opening dia 0.23mm (mask is 10um smaller per side than the bump, per datasheet note). Layout: 5 columns at uniform 0.6mm pitch - col1={pin2 top, pin1 bottom}, col2=pin3, col3=pin4, col4=pin5, col5={pin6 top, pin7 bottom}. Column-1 internal pad spacing ~0.68-0.70mm (matches full bar length, dim 'c'); column-5 internal pad spacing 0.45mm (dim 'h') - the two end columns are NOT mirror-symmetric. Edge clearances: die-edge-to-column-1 offset (dim e) 0.183mm nominal; a second edge/offset dimension near column 5 (dim i) 0.25mm nominal. Overall envelope 2.766 x 0.950mm, matches the die outline exactly (land = die footprint, direct solder-bar attach). Land pattern is solder-mask defined; recommended stencil is 4mil (100um) laser-cut with R60 corner radius, for SAC305 Type 3 solder (88.5% metals).
